effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` of vbETH (0xEE7D…aB62, the vault's immutable asset) to the vault through safeTransferFrom.
The vault mints gtWETH shares to `receiver`, rounded down from assets × totalSupply / lastTotalAssets after interest accrues.
The vault spends the signer's vbETH allowance to the vault by `assets`.
formats.shown: Deposit: the vbETH amount, the gtWETH share ticker and the address that receives the shares.

findings.title: deposit: the number of gtWETH shares received is computed on chain, so it is not shown.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.sol deposit: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor)`. The descriptor shows only the 'Share ticker' constant 'gtWETH', with no amount.
findings.fix: None possible. The amount depends on vault storage.

findings.title: deposit: the one-word intent 'Deposit' has no interpolated intent naming the amount, the asset and the share recipient.
findings.fix: Add interpolatedIntent "Deposit {assets} for gtWETH shares to {receiver}".

effects: The signer sends vbETH to the vault. The amount is computed and rounded up: shares × lastTotalAssets / totalSupply.
The vault mints exactly `shares` gtWETH to `receiver`.
The vault spends the signer's vbETH allowance to the vault by the computed amount.
formats.shown: Mint: the 'Deposit asset' is vbETH with no amount, then the exact gtWETH shares minted and the address that receives them.

findings.title: mint: the vbETH amount the signer pays is computed on chain and not shown; only the ticker is shown.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.sol mint: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil)`. The descriptor field 'Deposit asset' is the raw constant `$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker`. Case 1 shows 'Deposit asset: vbETH'.
findings.fix: None possible for the amount. The signer's allowance bounds it.

findings.title: mint: the intent 'Mint' hides that the signer pays vbETH; the payment appears only as a bare ticker.
findings.evidence: descriptor mint: `"intent": "Mint"`, with the field 'Deposit asset' = 'vbETH' and no amount (case 1).
findings.fix: Use intent 'Deposit for exact shares' and interpolatedIntent "Pay vbETH to mint {shares} to {receiver}"; relabel the field 'Pays with'.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault sends exactly `assets` vbETH to `receiver`.
The vault burns gtWETH shares from `owner`. The amount is computed and rounded up.
When the caller is not `owner`, the vault spends the owner's gtWETH allowance to the caller by the burned shares.
formats.shown: Withdraw: exactly the vbETH amount, the recipient and the owner whose shares are used.

findings.title: withdraw: the number of gtWETH shares burned from the owner is computed on chain and not shown.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.sol withdraw: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil)`; then ERC4626._withdraw calls `_burn(owner, shares)`.
findings.fix: None possible. The amount depends on vault storage.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` gtWETH from `owner`.
When the caller is not `owner`, the vault spends the owner's gtWETH allowance to the caller by `shares`.
The vault sends vbETH to `receiver`. The amount is computed and rounded down.
formats.shown: Redeem: the gtWETH shares to redeem, the recipient and the owner. The asset received is never named.

findings.title: redeem: no field names vbETH as the asset the receiver gets; mint has a constant ticker field for it.
findings.evidence: ERC4626._withdraw: `SafeERC20.safeTransfer(_asset, receiver, assets)`. The descriptor redeem fields are only 'Shares to redeem', 'To' and 'Owner'. Case 3 shows no underlying asset.
findings.fix: Add a field {"label":"Receive asset","format":"raw","value":"$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"} and an intent such as 'Redeem gtWETH for vbETH'.

findings.title: redeem: the vbETH amount received is computed on chain and has no minimum.
findings.fix: None possible. The amount depends on vault storage.
